_comment: High-water marks for connector-based incremental sync (see _manifest/SYNC.md). bump_watermark.py moves one after a successful sync, before its commit. One writer at a time: the committed watermark is the handoff between syncs. Keep only the sources you use.

granola.note: Latest distilled meeting date (day-granular). Incremental = meetings since this date, minus those already holding a granola:<id> note, distilled by _granola-pending/granola_new.mjs. Null until the first sync completes.

gmail_personal.account: <the Gmail account the Claude Gmail connector is signed in to>
gmail_personal.note: Latest distilled thread date (day-granular). Incremental = search_threads(after:<date>), minus threads already holding a gmail:thread:<id> note (gmail_worklist.py). Grown threads go to gmail_update.mjs, which does not move this watermark.

gmail_secondary.account: <the secondary account exported with Google Takeout>
gmail_secondary.note: Latest distilled thread date of the mbox pipeline (gmail_secondary_select.py -> gmail_secondary_worklist.py -> gmail_secondary_distill.mjs).

outlook.note: Latest distilled thread date (day-granular). A backlog source: a computed watermark behind this one is a no-op, not an error. Export .eml files after this date into _sources/outlook/.

imessage.note: TIMESTAMP regime (ISO-8601 UTC): the max message instant imsg_extract.py processed (_sources/imessage.maxts). Pass it to imsg_select.py / imsg_extract.py --since.

whatsapp.source: the native Mac WhatsApp app's ChatStorage.sqlite
whatsapp.note: TIMESTAMP regime, like imessage (_sources/whatsapp.maxts). whatsapp_extract.py WITHOUT --since is a full backfill.
